title: regional capacity pledge + contacts (aug 2028)
summary: One-page ad-hoc tracker to collect short-term GPU/instance pledges and primary contacts for regional fallback coverage during the September performance window. This is intentionally lightweight: teams enter committed capacity and a single primary contact. SRE will use this to route emergency traffic and to contact owners for quick scale-ups.

instructions: How to use: add a new row for your region and pledge window. Keep 'Committed GPUs' to the minimum unit we can allocate (see notes). If you cannot commit GPUs, add 'Volunteer pool' and estimated availability %. SRE will ping primary Slack handle first. Update 'Last Update' each time you change numbers.
next_steps: 1) Collect final confirmations by 2028-08-20. 2) SRE to publish a condensed emergency routing map and add to the Regional Fallback Playbook. 3) Ops to run a short smoke test on 2028-08-28 to verify connectivity and model fallbacks.
ownership_notes: Owner (Priya Raman) will maintain this sheet until final handoff to Oncall lead. For large pledge changes (>+4 GPUs), please file ENG-3421 and notify on #infra-oncall.
risks_and_assumptions: Assumes pledged GPUs will be reachable and not fully reserved by other internal pipelines. Network egress and cross-account IAM need pre-approval for partner pools. Quantized fallback variants may not preserve latency SLOs.
audit_trail: Initial create: 2028-08-12 Priya Raman. Major update: 2028-08-13 María Santos added us-east-1 pledge. Final confirmations pending.
export_hint: This sheet is intentionally compact; if you need a CSV export for on-call tooling, use the header row in sheet_rows[0] and join subsequent rows.
